addressing.viega_manual: PDU = manual address - 30000 for input, - 40000 for holding; do not subtract another 1
addressing.other_clients: A client using holding 40001 = PDU 0 calls PDU 100 register 40101
addressing.room_id: 1..12; obtain from each actuator's room_id register; not native slot 1..8, actor index, or screen order

operating_mode.scope: Whole base unit, shared by every room

profile_mode.constraint: Only in heating mode; whole base unit

room_error.note: Existing room diagnostic only; not Connect capability/source/ageTicks

room_target_temperature.note: Original manual pp92-93 gives 5/16..30degC depending on context. Do not conflate with Connect's measured-temperature 5..40degC. Existing HA climate accepts 5..30; no new wider setpoint range is promised.

external_measured_temperature.effect: Native external measured-temperature processing, including validity refresh; does not change setpoint

room_power_level.note: Original ROOM power-level register; not proven to address a detached standalone actor. Do not substitute actorId for roomId.

standalone_actor_power.note: Native per-actor power exists in Connect, but no actor power Modbus address is specified by these PDFs. Omit standalone actor power writes until the existing web/API owner provides exact native Modbus evidence. Do not invent new firmware registers.

wifi_serial.encoding: Big-endian register bytes; trim trailing NUL/space
wifi_serial.identity: WiFi module, distinct from base/PIC serial

invalid_read_sentinel.rule: Detect before scaling; never write sentinel or substitute 21degC

connect_gate.policy: Explicit user Connect Upgrade opt-in and confirmation that chosen rooms already use Extern gemeten; no probe writes
connect_gate.external_mode_selection: Existing Fonterra web UI; no new Modbus register or automatic fallback

freshness.device: Native PIC ageTicks <=12000 and valid PIC status; ticks are not seconds; original timeout remains authoritative
freshness.modbus_limit: No documented Modbus source/status/reason/ageTicks registers. Equal readback alone is NOT proof of current PIC freshness. Do not invent register addresses or seconds conversion.
freshness.sender: Periodically resend only real finite 5..40degC measurements while source report time remains recent. Equal-valued actual reports refresh report time; no new physical report means source eventually expires.
freshness.home_assistant: State.last_reported, never last_changed. Reject restored/unknown/unavailable/invalid values. KNX always_callback=true and sync_state=expire 5 allow equal telegrams and periodic bus reads. No cached-value heartbeat templates.

ha_candidate.note: Sender defaults, not a claimed conversion of PIC ticks; physical timeout acceptance still required

write_failure: No immediate retry after a lost acknowledgement. Verify WLAN identity and actor assignment before sending on a later poll. Stop on missing, invalid or expired readings. The native diagnostics report device faults.
proof: Viega Fonterra Smart Control 2.0 manual, Modbus register tables and worked examples
